expectations.text: Puts most promotion effort into the final week
expectations.evidence: The transcript says this directly in its effort list: "Owned-channel promotion, with most of it in each episode's final week." It supports this with Livestorm data showing 49.6% of registrations come in the final 7 days. For episode 1, it also moves the main push to the week of 2027-01-05, the week before the 2027-01-12 session.

expectations.text: Puts most promotion effort into the final week
expectations.evidence: The plan never says to concentrate promotion in the final week before a session. It opens registration 3 weeks out and puts the owned-channel push and LinkedIn test in weeks 4–6. Two points lean toward the final week without making it the main focus: it keeps late registration open ('Late registrants show up at the highest rate'), and its reminders run at T-24h, T-1h and T-10min. Those reminders drive show-up, not promotion.
